tool.name: SAFRAN Climate Data Extractor
tool.description: Download SAFRAN daily climate reanalysis data from the GEOSAS OGC-EDR API (France, 1958–present)
tool.command:
python '$__tool_directory__/safran_extract.py'
## ── Climate parameters ───────────────────────────────────────────── --parameters #for $param in $climate_parameters '${param}' #end for
--coord-format '$coord_file.ext'
## ── Date range ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── #if str($date_range.start_date).strip() != '' --start-date '${date_range.start_date}' #end if #if str($date_range.end_date).strip() != '' --end-date '${date_range.end_date}' #end if
## ── Coordinate file ──────────────────────────────────────────────── --coord-file '$coord_file'
## ── Coordinate reference system ──────────────────────────────────── --epsg $epsg
## ── Output format ────────────────────────────────────────────────── --format '$output_format'
## ── Output path (managed by Galaxy) ──────────────────────────────── --output '$output'

param.name: climate_parameters
param.label: Climate variables to download
param.help: Select one or more SAFRAN daily variables. The list is fetched live from the GéoSAS API — it reflects the variables actually available at query time. Hold Ctrl (Windows/Linux) or Cmd (macOS) to select multiple items.

validator.message: Unable to retrieve the parameter list from the GéoSAS API. Please check your network connection and try again.

param.name: start_date
param.label: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
param.help: First day of the extraction period. Cannot be before 1958-08-01 (oldest SAFRAN record). Leave blank only if the coordinate file already contains a 'begin_date' column; otherwise required. Default fallback: 1960-01-01. Format is validated by the tool (YYYY-MM-DD required).

validator.message: Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format (or left blank).

param.name: end_date
param.label: End date (YYYY-MM-DD)
param.help: Last day of the extraction period (inclusive). SAFRAN is updated monthly; data up to near-present is available. Leave blank only if the coordinate file already contains an 'end_date' column; otherwise required. Default fallback: 2020-12-31. Format is validated by the tool (YYYY-MM-DD required).

validator.message: Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format (or left blank).

param.name: coord_file
param.label: Coordinate / geometry file
param.help: File describing the location(s) to query (CSV, TSV, Excel, Shapefile, or GeoJSON). Geometry type and required columns are detected automatically — see the help below for details.

param.name: epsg
param.label: EPSG code of the coordinates
param.help: Coordinate reference system of the input geometries. Check the help section for more information If unsure, use 4326 and provide decimal-degree coordinates.

param.name: output_format
param.label: Output file format
param.help:
Format of the downloaded climate data.
CSV — Tabular; easy to open in R, Python, or Excel. CoverageJSON — OGC CoverageJSON with spatial metadata. netCDF4 — Gridded format. Recommended for polygon / large queries. parquet — Columnar binary. Only for POINT / LINESTRING inputs.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What this tool does**
Downloads daily **SAFRAN** climate reanalysis data from the **GEOSAS OGC-EDR API** (INRAE, Rennes) for one or more locations in metropolitan France, defined via a coordinate or geometry file.
**More details on EPSG code of the coordinates** The GEOSAS API re-projects internally. Most common values: - 4326 — WGS84 geographic, decimal degrees (default) - 2154 — RGF93 / Lambert-93 (France, metric) - 32631 — WGS84 / UTM zone 31N (metric) ----
**The GEOSAS OGC-EDR API**
The service implements the OGC **Environmental Data Retrieval** (EDR) v1.1 standard:
https://api.geosas.fr/edr/collections/safran-isba/
It exposes exactly two query endpoints:
+------------+---------------------------------------------+---------------------+ | Endpoint | Used for | Key parameter | +============+=============================================+=====================+ | /position | POINT, MULTIPOINT, LINESTRING | ``coords=WKT`` | +------------+---------------------------------------------+---------------------+ | /cube | Bounding box (POLYGON or bbox column) | ``bbox=x1,y1,x2,y2``| +------------+---------------------------------------------+---------------------+
----
**Geometry routing (automatic)**
The geometry type in your file is detected automatically:
* **POINT** (lat/lon columns) → ``/position`` * **LINESTRING** (WKT column) → ``/position`` (vertices extracted as MULTIPOINT) * **POLYGON** (WKT column) → ``/cube`` (bounding box of the polygon extracted) * **bbox column** ("minx,miny,maxx,maxy" string) → ``/cube``
Per-row ``begin_date`` / ``end_date`` columns override the global date range.
----
**Required columns for CSV / Excel input**
* **POINT** — a ``latitude`` (or ``lat``) column and a ``longitude`` (or ``lon``) column. * **POLYGON / LINESTRING** — a ``geometry`` or ``wkt`` column containing WKT text.
Optional ``begin_date`` / ``end_date`` columns (``YYYY-MM-DD``) override the global date range for each individual row.
----
**Available climate variables**
The list of available variables is fetched live from the GéoSAS API at form-load time. Each variable is shown as ``CODE — description`` in the selector above. For the current full list with units, see:
https://api.geosas.fr/edr/collections/safran-isba/
The ``parameter_names`` field of that JSON response is the authoritative source.
----
**Coordinate file examples**
*POINT (WGS84, decimal degrees)*::
id,latitude,longitude montpellier,43.6047,3.8722 paris,48.8566,2.3522
*POLYGON (WKT column — bounding box sent to /cube)*::
id,geometry watershed_A,"POLYGON((3.2 43.4, 3.9 43.4, 3.9 43.9, 3.2 43.9, 3.2 43.4))"
*LINESTRING (vertices extracted as MULTIPOINT)*::
id,geometry transect_NS,"LINESTRING(2.35 43.0, 2.35 44.0, 2.35 45.0, 2.35 46.0)"
*Bounding box column (sent directly to /cube)*::
id,bbox,begin_date,end_date bretagne,"-5,47,-1,49",1990-01-01,2000-12-31 alsace,"7.0,47.5,8.3,48.9",2000-01-01,2010-12-31
*Per-row date override*::
id,latitude,longitude,begin_date,end_date site_A,43.6047,3.8722,1970-01-01,1999-12-31 site_B,45.7640,4.8357,2000-01-01,2020-12-31 site_C,48.8566,2.3522,,
``site_C`` has empty date cells → the global start / end dates are used.
----
.. class:: warningmark
**Known limitations**
* SAFRAN only covers **metropolitan France**. Queries outside this domain will return an API error. * The ``/cube`` (polygon / bbox) endpoint returns data for the **bounding box**, not the polygon shape itself. * ``parquet`` format is only available for ``/position`` queries (POINT / LINESTRING). * Long date ranges or large bounding boxes may exceed the default 120 s timeout. Enable **Verbose logging** to diagnose slow requests.
